notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 11
notes.content: [p]Playtest version 0.1.0.444 has just gone live! Changes: [/p][list][*][p]Added new item, Scepter of Shift (moves the crown to a new location),[/p][/*][*][p]Added new item, Half Roller (reduces maximum roll for your next turn to 5),[/p][/*][*][p]Added item rarity system to make some items appear more often vs others,[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixes: [/p][list][*][p]Fix "Get Crown" sound sometimes playing twice on client[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 10
notes.content: [p]Playtest version 0.1.0.439 has just gone live![/p][p]Changes:[/p][p]- Limit number of saves to 10[/p][p]- Sort save files by last time the file has been modified[/p][p]- Delete games save file after game is over[/p][p]Fixes:[/p][p]- Fixed lobby slot not being usable if player leaves during character selection[/p][p]- Fixed being able to take over other players characters in the character select screen if a client leaves and rejoins[/p][p]- Fixed "toggle ready" sound effect playing if a player leaves after the game started[/p][p]- Fixed "Last Turn" text displaying wrong text[/p][p]- Fixed save file not working sometimes if map has been changed[/p]

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 9
notes.content: [p]Playtest version 0.1.0.438 has just gone live! Changes: [/p][list][*][p]Updated item card colors and their meanings[/p][list][*][p]Orange = Negative effect,[/p][/*][*][p]Lime = Neutral effect,[/p][/*][*][p]Cyan = Positive effect,[/p][/*][*][p]Purple = Rare Special item,[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Minigame Cubic Crisis Climb can now end in a draw[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixes: [/p][list][*][p]Player rotation between rounds of minigame Seaside Scavengers now properly resets[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 8
notes.content: [p]Playtest version 0.1.0.436 has just gone live![/p][p]Changes:[/p][p]- improved minigame character collision[/p][p]Fixes:[/p][p]- Fixed some instances where bots could get stuck after taking over a player[/p][p]- Fixed issue that would break minigames in multiplayer under certain conditions[/p]

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 7
notes.content: [p]Playtest version 0.1.0.433 has just gone live! Changes: [/p][list][*][p]Change Item placement to allow for placing items 5 places ahead and backwards, instead of just forwards,[/p][/*][*][p]Added another free item space to Beachy Beach,[/p][/*][*][p]Made the shop cost and use cost of all items cheaper to make them more viable,[/p][/*][*][p]Improve physics on grenades in minigame FragBallFury,[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixes: [/p][list][*][p]Fixed coins on minigame Lawn loot rumble snapping position,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed misaligned grenades on minigame FragBallFury[/p][/*][/list][p]Special thanks to discord member Kunai Kazekun for providing critical feedback for this update![/p]
